# Annex H: PROTEUS Risk-Tier Examples

This annex assigns example risk tiers (low, medium and high) to representative PROTEUS models, datasets, agents and use case outputs, following the tier descriptions used in the risk register. Each example states the tier, the reasons for it (the severity and reversibility of possible harm, the sensitivity of the people and places involved, and the degree of autonomy), and the review and oversight it triggers, such as a mandatory human check before release or escalation to the External Advisory Board. The examples range from exploratory research outputs and monitoring products used for planning to outputs that inform emergency response or concern vulnerable populations. The tier assignments are proposals for discussion with the partners and use case leads, and they are revised after the first self-assessments.
